description: AGSC-07-20: each pack is accompanied by a SHA-256 lockfile carried as the lock member of its entry in /skills/index.json, AGSC-06-01 emitting no other route for one. The lock member is {"SKILL.md": <hex>}, the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the pack's SKILL.md bytes. Derivation over the minimal fixture, built with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set and no git history: one pack, agent-patterns; its lock has exactly the one member SKILL.md (lock_members), and that value is 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits equal to the SHA-256 of the bytes the build serves at the entry's path (lock_is_sha256_of_skill_md). No route other than the index carries a lock: no emitted route ends in .lock or names a lockfile (no_lock_route). The bytes of SKILL.md are an implementation's, so the case pins the relation between the two files and not either digest.
